name: BioRED 权威通用标准 (NIH/NLM 基准)
description: 基于美国国立卫生研究院 BioRED 国际标准的通用生物医学实体与关系分类体系，覆盖分子、细胞、微生物、器官解剖至物种宿主的全尺度生物医学研究场景。

Gene_Protein.label: 基因 / 蛋白质 / RNA
Gene_Protein.description: 编码或非编码核酸、功能性蛋白质、酶、受体蛋白及分子亚基
Gene_Protein.en_description: Coding and non-coding nucleic acids, functional proteins, enzymes, receptors, and molecular subunits.

Chemical_Drug.label: 化学小分子 / 药物 / 代谢物
Chemical_Drug.description: 外源化合物、合成药物先导物、内源代谢物、无机离子与生化试剂
Chemical_Drug.en_description: Exogenous small molecules, synthetic drug leads, endogenous metabolites, biochemical ions, and reagents.

Disease_Phenotype.label: 疾病 / 病理表型
Disease_Phenotype.description: 临床疾病、病理状态、异常生理指征或组织病变
Disease_Phenotype.en_description: Clinical diseases, pathological conditions, physiological abnormalities, and tissue lesions.

Biological_Process.label: 生物学过程 / 信号通路
Biological_Process.description: 细胞内信号级联、生理功能反应、代谢过程与程序性死亡
Biological_Process.en_description: Intracellular signaling cascades, physiological responses, metabolic processes, and programmed cell death.

Cell_CellLine.label: 细胞亚群 / 模式细胞系
Cell_CellLine.description: 免疫细胞亚群、原代细胞、干细胞及模式细胞系 (如 T细胞、HeLa、Jurkat)
Cell_CellLine.en_description: Immune cell subpopulations, primary cells, stem cells, and model cell lines (e.g. T cells, HeLa, Jurkat).

Organ_Tissue.label: 组织器官 / 解剖学系统
Organ_Tissue.description: 解剖学器官、组织切片、生理系统与屏障 (如 脑、肝脏、心血管系统、血脑屏障)
Organ_Tissue.en_description: Anatomical organs, tissue sections, physiological systems, and biological barriers (e.g. brain, liver, CNS, BBB).

Species_Organism.label: 物种 / 宿主 / 模式生物
Species_Organism.description: 生物宿主、人类受试者及模式生物 (如 人类 Homo sapiens、小鼠 Mus musculus、斑马鱼、果蝇)
Species_Organism.en_description: Biological hosts, human subjects, and model organisms (e.g. Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, zebrafish, Drosophila).

Microbe_Pathogen.label: 微生物 / 细菌 / 病毒 / 病原体
Microbe_Pathogen.description: 致病病毒、共生/致病细菌、真菌、寄生虫及微生物群落 (如 SARS-CoV-2、大肠杆菌、幽门螺杆菌、肠道菌群)
Microbe_Pathogen.en_description: Pathogenic viruses, commensal and pathogenic bacteria, fungi, parasites, and microbiota (e.g. SARS-CoV-2, E. coli).

Sequence_Variant.label: 突变位点 / 基因变异
Sequence_Variant.description: 点突变、单核苷酸多态性(SNP)、插入缺失或染色体变异
Sequence_Variant.en_description: Point mutations, single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), indels, copy-number variations (CNVs), and amino-acid alterations.

Uncertain.label: 无法判断 / 未定概念
Uncertain.description: 文献证据不足或上下文含糊、无法明确归类的概念
Uncertain.en_description: Concepts lacking sufficient literature evidence, ambiguous abbreviations, or unidentifiable entities.

Positive_Regulation.label: 正向调控 / 激活 / 促进
Positive_Regulation.en_description: Upregulation, activation, stimulation, expression induction, or catalytic enhancement.

Negative_Regulation.label: 负向调控 / 抑制 / 降解
Negative_Regulation.en_description: Downregulation, inhibition, suppression, degradation, or pathway blockade.

Physical_Binding.label: 物理结合 / 复合物组装
Physical_Binding.en_description: Direct physical protein-protein/ligand-receptor binding or stable complex assembly.

Catalysis_Conversion.label: 催化 / 生化转化
Catalysis_Conversion.en_description: Enzymatic biochemical reaction, post-translational modification, or metabolic conversion.

Infection_Pathogenesis.label: 感染 / 宿主入侵 / 致病机制
Infection_Pathogenesis.en_description: Microbial infection, host cell entry, virulence mechanism, or pathological progression.

Localization_Targeting.label: 定位 / 组织靶向
Localization_Targeting.en_description: Subcellular/tissue localization, anatomical homing, or organ targeting.

Association_Correlation.label: 一般关联 / 相互作用
Association_Correlation.en_description: General clinical correlation, functional linkage, or co-expression.

Hierarchy_Component.label: 从属组成 / 亚基归属
Hierarchy_Component.en_description: Structural subunit, molecular complex component, or hierarchical containment.

en_description: Universal biomedical taxonomy based on the NIH/NLM BioRED standard, spanning molecules, cells, pathogens, tissues/anatomy, and host organisms.
